def find_max_gap(sequence, target):
    n = len(sequence)
    subset_sums = set()
    
    # Iterate through all 2^n subsets
    for i in range(1 << n):
        current_sum = 0
        for j in range(n):
            if (i >> j) & 1:
                current_sum += sequence[j]
        subset_sums.add(current_sum)
        
    # Find the minimal gap to the target
    min_gap = float('inf')
    for s in subset_sums:
        gap = abs(s - target)
        min_gap = min(min_gap, gap)
        
    return min_gap
